name: Reel
author: Izumi
description: Modelled on the AnimePahe watch page: a flat charcoal canvas, a top bar, no featured banner, and Home as a grid of 16:9 snapshot tiles with the format pinned to each still. The watch page docks the player at the top with the server switcher and an episode snapshot grid beneath it; the series page lists episodes as snapshots with an episode badge. On phones the same grid runs under a flush bottom bar with a line marker.
